name: Proofpoint — Image-Based (QR) Phishing Attachment Delivered
xql_query:
datamodel dataset = proofpoint_tap_raw
| filter (proofpoint_tap_raw.classification = "PHISHING" or proofpoint_tap_raw.classification = "IMPOSTOR" or proofpoint_tap_raw.phishScore > 50)
| filter proofpoint_tap_raw.messageParts contains "image/png" or proofpoint_tap_raw.messageParts contains "image/jpeg" or proofpoint_tap_raw.messageParts contains ".png" or proofpoint_tap_raw.messageParts contains ".jpg"
| alter recip = arrayindex(xdm.email.recipients, 0)
| alter senderIP = proofpoint_tap_raw.senderIP,
        clickIP = proofpoint_tap_raw.clickIP,
        id = proofpoint_tap_raw.id,
        GUID = proofpoint_tap_raw.GUID,
        subject = proofpoint_tap_raw.subject,
        xmailer = proofpoint_tap_raw.xmailer,
        headerCC = proofpoint_tap_raw.headerCC,
        headerTo = proofpoint_tap_raw.headerTo,
        policyRoutes = proofpoint_tap_raw.policyRoutes,
        threatID = proofpoint_tap_raw.threatID,
        clickTime = proofpoint_tap_raw.clickTime,
        messageID = proofpoint_tap_raw.messageID,
        spamScore = proofpoint_tap_raw.spamScore,
        threatURL = proofpoint_tap_raw.threatURL,
        campaignId = proofpoint_tap_raw.campaignId,
        sender = proofpoint_tap_raw.sender,
        threatTime = proofpoint_tap_raw.threatTime,
        headerFrom = proofpoint_tap_raw.headerFrom,
        messageSize = proofpoint_tap_raw.messageSize,
        malwareScore = proofpoint_tap_raw.malwareScore,
        messageParts = proofpoint_tap_raw.messageParts,
        threatStatus = proofpoint_tap_raw.threatStatus,
        impostorScore = proofpoint_tap_raw.impostorScore,
        phishScore = proofpoint_tap_raw.phishScore,
        url = proofpoint_tap_raw.url,
        threatsInfoMap = proofpoint_tap_raw.threatsInfoMap,
        classification = proofpoint_tap_raw.classification,
        headerReplyTo = proofpoint_tap_raw.headerReplyTo,
        quarantineRule = proofpoint_tap_raw.quarantineRule,
        replyToAddress = proofpoint_tap_raw.replyToAddress,
        quarantineFolder = proofpoint_tap_raw.quarantineFolder
description: Proofpoint delivered email with PHISHING/IMPOSTOR classification AND messageParts containing image/png, image/jpeg, .png, or .jpg — QR-code phishing pattern.
